overall_assessment: The two non-empty plans (KRLE 2) are complete and well structured; the 'long' flag is a false alarm (genuinely long 30 ECTS plans). But 8 of the 8 random controls have a fetched page and empty extracted text, so the large majority of NLA offerings with a page get no text; this is the institution-wide problem.

findings.description: All 8 random controls (2020-2024, both semesters, old 4MGL* and newer MGL* codes) have a fetched page (URL with a year suffix) but empty extracted text. Context: 1803 offerings with a fetched page but only 249 with text. The pre-pass 'empty' flag is switched off for nla, so none of these are flagged. data_notes says a row with a page but no plan is an academic year missing from the page's JSON, but a rate of about 86% empty is far higher than that explanation would suggest, so the year mapping or JSON lookup may be failing.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: json block reader in R/blocks.R (.nla_academic_year_from_course_id and the EmneplanPage lookup) finds no entry for the requested academic year: key mismatch (e.g. format of year key, 'Nytt'/'Aktivt' status entries, Norwegian multi-year entries), or the JSON of the fetched page only holds a few recent years regardless of the URL year suffix.
findings.suggested_fix: Take 5 of the empty offerings, list the year keys actually present in the page's EmneplanPage JSON and compare them with .nla_academic_year_from_course_id(); fix the key mapping if they match in content, and otherwise document the gap per course-year (target gaps). Consider an nla-specific empty check so the pre-pass reports it.
